title: Page 10
slug: 娇妃要和离-风光-娘子人如其名温柔了时光款款向我走来-欸娘子别动手本郡王真不是故意成亲就失忆-谁能比她温柔倒楣郡王夫君成
content_zh:
崔静言夫妻停了步，他不以为然地转向了那群人，嗤之以鼻地道：「我这是对妻子的尊重！哪像你们一个个都不懂得体贴夫人，天天相敬如宾，相处起来跟拜见同僚一样，有什么意思？夫妻和乐才是做人的根本，家不齐，何以治国平天下？」
这番大道理令众人一噎，早知道调侃一句会换来迎头痛击，他们早就闭上嘴。
讵料崔静言还不满意，指着方才先发难的人说道：「吴侍郎，你方才与夫人是分开进宫赴宴的吧？你有没有想过万一吴夫人的马车半路出什么情况，你在宫里根本无法知道，这样好吗？」
吴侍郎支支吾吾，一下答不上来。
崔静言其实根本不想听他回话，炮口又指向了另一个人。「崇平侯世子，听说令夫人素来温和，以脾气好着称，上回不小心被个下人冲撞了还反过来向对方道歉。啧啧啧，能把妻子训练得如此柔弱，世子不愧剽悍之名啊！」
崇平侯世子哑口无语，崔静言这是把方才他揶揄的话全还回来了。
点到为止就够了，崔静言也不想得罪每一个人，他只是想表达他与温柔纯粹就是感情好，好到她可以在他面前恣意。
「所以，什么惧内之说，根本是无稽之谈。」最后，崔静言强调。
能当上官员就没一个傻的，反应比较快的纷纷称道起崔静言的体贴，还有的女眷干脆吹捧起温柔，羡慕她能有个如此气量的夫君。
然而真是这样吗？温柔斜睨了崔静言一眼，这个男人，真是无时无刻不孔雀开屏，替他自己造势长脸啊！
她突然朝崔静言勾了勾手，然后在他耳边低声地说了几句话。
众人偷偷观察着小夫妻的互动，只看到温柔不知说了什么，崔静言瞪大了眼一脸惊吓地呆立许久，恍惚着无法回神。
温柔不理会这傻男人，打算自个儿随宫人进后宫去，但崔静言马上清醒了，也不管一堆文武官员看着，连忙跟了上去，小心翼翼地搀住了温柔。
「你累吗？有没有哪里不舒服？如果不想赴宴，要不我带你回府？」
「你放心，我壮着呢！」温柔一阵好笑，仍是执意进宫。
这对话听在众官的耳中，怎么听怎么奇怪，肉麻得他们都忍不住打了个寒噤。想不到崔静言语毕真的扶着温柔像扶祖宗一样，一路扶到了不能再入的地方，然后做了一件令众人都差点惊掉眼珠子的举动。
他拦下了宫里宁国大长公主原本备给安阳县主的空轿，逼着宫人将温柔抬进后宫之内。
「柔柔，乘轿比较舒服，你小心坐，我让他们轻轻抬……」
他把妻子送进别人的轿子不说，还温言软语地奉承着，让好些人看得牙都酸了。
「这难道还不是惧内吗……」

刚刚被崔静言消遣了一顿的吴侍郎忍不住咕哝了一句，只是这回不敢大声了，还与崇平侯世子交换了个心照不宣的眼神。
「喂喂，你们看，安阳县主来了，这会儿有好戏看了！」突然，又有人低声叫了起来。
众官员本来就要散去，听到这叫声又全停下脚步准备看好戏。
安阳县主倾慕宁化郡王的事众所皆知，现在宁化郡王为妻子抢了安阳县主的轿子，那还不得闹起来？
果然，安阳县主一来就眼睁睁看着崔静言将温柔扶上母亲替她准备的轿子，那呵护备至的模样让她不由气苦。
「表哥，就算你不喜……」接下来的话，她不好在大庭广众下说，只能气得跺脚。「也不能让温柔抢我的轿子啊！」
在崔昊日及大长公主多次开导，又听说崔静言与温柔夫唱妇随一起领兵勤王的消息后，安阳县主早就熄了对崔静言的那点心思。可是即便如此，不代表崔静言就能不顾她的脸面替妻子抢了她的轿子！
「她现在比你需要。」崔静言连个眼神都没给她，专心一意地深情看着自己的妻子。
「她是个武将，我是个弱女子，她会比我需要？表哥你太偏心，我一定要告诉娘！」
「你尽量去说！大长公主要是知道了也会支持我这么做！」
「你……」安阳县主简直要哭出来。
旁边官员津津有味地看着这场好戏，一边还私下讨论道——
「你们说谁会吵赢？」
「安阳县主吧！毕竟宁化郡王是惧内，安阳县主她怕什么？」
才这么讨论着，就看到崔静言低声与安阳县主说了什么，任偷看的众官员拉长耳朵也听不清内容，而后只见安阳县主一脸惊讶地望向轿子里的温柔，伸手就向温柔抓去。
「要打起来了要打起来了……」官员们屏息以待。
想不到安阳县主只是将手伸进去，将温柔背后的软垫调整好，然后也像崔静言那样显得有些慌乱且紧张地说道：「温柔，你……轿子给你坐吧！这几个人抬轿子够稳的，你放心吧，我会帮你看着，不会颠着你的……」
于是在众人面面相觑的傻眼情况下，轿子被抬走了，安阳县主甚至直接跟在了旁边，感觉比崔静言还要护着轿子。
崔静言一直看到见不到轿子才施施然回头，向众人点头示意后慢慢离去。
而一群看傻了的文武官员们，待到主角们走光了才齐齐长吁了口气。

「原来宁化郡王自己惧内就罢了，这种惧内还会影响旁人啊，以后可得离他远点，免得被感染了……」
然而在女眷那处，又是截然不同的状况——
「原来宁化郡王妃不仅能让郡王服服贴贴，还能让安阳县主也服服贴贴，以后可得和她好好亲近亲近，看看人家是怎么办到的啊……」
尾声 还是继续失忆好了
五年后，温柔与崔静言有了一子一女，小男孩今年五岁，是个聪明机灵的小子。晋王说此子日后大有可为，曾在孩子三岁时，因为温柔再次怀孕，受不得吵，晋王夫妇便将他带到太原去陪爷爷奶奶住了一整年，亲自教导为人处事。
至于小女孩才两岁，生得玉雪可爱，最喜欢撒娇，那软萌娇嫩的声音一叫起人，能让人心都化了，恨不得把全世界捧到她面前。与她的小兄长相反，小女孩因为太可爱，晋王夫妇为了她特地留京一年，怕错过太多小孙女的成长。
有了这么一对孩子，温柔与崔静言反而更显出了夫妻的契合，教养孩子的想法相去不远，也不会因为孩子的打扰而起龃龉，自是夫妻相得，一如往常的恩爱。
他们都不认为孩子什么都不懂，与孩子们相处时，说话应对都与大人无异，尊重孩子的想法，所以哥哥与妹妹会说话之后表达都相当清晰，思路清楚，每每带出门都是备受称赞的聪慧孩子。
这一日，崔静言在书房生停步，像大人那样拱手作揖。
「爹，孩儿有事想请教。」男孩个头小小的，但可有礼貌了。
「过来坐下。」崔静言朝他招招手，让儿子在他身边坐下，然后把桌上放点心的食盒推到儿子面前。「你想请教爹什么事？」
男孩要问的事实在困扰了他一阵子，所以也没心情吃点心，只是睁着琉璃珠子般的墨黑大眼，充满好奇地问道：「爹与娘刚成亲时，是不是有撞到头失忆过？」
崔静言正在斟茶的手停在了半空。
「有。」他纳闷地看向小男孩。「你怎么知道？」
content_en:
Cui Jingyan and his wife stopped walking. He turned to the group of people disapprovingly and sneered: "This is how I respect my wife! How can you not be considerate of your wife? Treat each other as guests every day, and get along with each other like a colleague. What's the point? Harmony between husband and wife is the foundation of life. If the family is not harmonious, how can we govern the country and bring peace to the world?"
This great truth made everyone choke. If they had known that a joke would result in a head-on blow, they would have shut up long ago.
Unexpectedly, Cui Jingyan was still dissatisfied. She pointed at the person who had attacked first and said, "Secretary Wu, did you and your wife enter the palace separately for the banquet just now? Have you ever thought that if something happens to Mrs. Wu's carriage on the way, you will have no way of knowing in the palace. Is this okay?"
Wu Shilang hesitated and couldn't answer at once.
In fact, Cui Jingyan didn't want to hear his reply at all, and pointed the gun at another person. "Prince Chongping, I heard that Madam Ling has always been gentle and known for her good temper. Last time she was accidentally bumped into by a servant and she even apologized to him in return. Tsk, tsk, tsk, you can train your wife to be so weak. The prince is worthy of his reputation as a tough one!"
Prince Chongping was speechless. Cui Jingyan returned all the teasing words he had just said.
That's enough. Cui Jingyan doesn't want to offend everyone. He just wants to express that he and Wen Wen are simply in a good relationship, so good that she can do whatever she wants in front of him.
"So, the theory of henpeck is completely nonsense." Finally, Cui Jingyan emphasized.
No one would be stupid if they could become an official. Those who reacted quickly praised Cui Jingyan for her thoughtfulness. Some female relatives simply praised her gentleness and envied her for having such a generous husband.
But is this really the case? Wen Wen glanced sideways at Cui Jingyan, this man was really spreading his wings all the time, trying to create momentum for himself!
She suddenly hooked her hand towards Cui Jingyan, and then whispered a few words in his ear.
Everyone secretly observed the young couple's interaction, only to see Wen Wenwen saying something unknown. Cui Jingyan stood there for a long time with wide eyes and a frightened face, in a trance and unable to recover.
Wen Wen ignored the silly man and planned to follow the palace people into the harem alone, but Cui Jingyan immediately woke up and followed up quickly, regardless of the crowd of civil and military officials watching, and carefully supported Wen Wen.
"Are you tired? Are you feeling uncomfortable somewhere? If you don't want to go to the banquet, how about I take you home?"
"Don't worry, I'm strong!" Wen Wen was amused for a while, but still insisted on entering the palace.
This conversation sounded strange to the ears of all the officials. It was so disgusting that they couldn't help but shudder. Unexpectedly, Cui Jing really supported Wen Wenwen like an ancestor, all the way to the point of no return, and then did something that almost shocked everyone.
He stopped the empty sedan chair originally intended for the lord of Anyang County by Princess Ningguo in the palace, and forced the palace attendants to carry Wen Wenwen into the harem.
"Rourou, it's more comfortable to ride in a sedan. You sit carefully and I'll let them lift it gently..."
Not only did he send his wife into someone else's sedan, but he even flattered her softly, which made many people's teeth ache.
"Isn't this henpecking..."
Wu Shilang, who had just been entertained by Cui Jingyan, couldn't help but muttered something, but he didn't dare to speak loudly this time, and exchanged a tacit look with Prince Chongping Hou.
"Hey, look, the Anyang County Lord is here, there's something good to watch now!" Suddenly, someone shouted again in a low voice.
The officials were about to disperse, but when they heard the cry, they all stopped and prepared to watch the show.
It is well known that the Lord of Anyang County admires the Prince of Ninghua County. Now that the Prince of Ninghua County has snatched the Anyang County Lord's sedan chair for his wife, why should there be a riot?
Sure enough, as soon as Anyang County Lord arrived, he watched Cui Jingyan help Wen Wenwen onto the sedan chair her mother had prepared for her. The caring look on her face made her feel bitter.
"Cousin, even if you don't like it..." What she said next was not good for herIf you say it in public, you can only stamp your feet in anger. "I can't let Wenrou snatch my sedan chair!"
After Cui Haori and the eldest princess repeatedly enlightened her, and after hearing the news that Cui Jingyan and the gentle couple were leading the troops to serve the king, Anyang County Lord had long since given up on Cui Jingyan. But even so, it doesn't mean that Cui Jingyan can steal the sedan for his wife regardless of her face!
"She needs you more than you do right now." Cui Jingyan didn't even give her a look, but concentrated on looking at his wife affectionately.
"She is a military commander and I am a weak woman. She needs more than me? Cousin, you are too partial. I must tell my mother!"
"Try your best to say it! If the eldest princess knows about it, she will support me in doing this!"
"You..." Anyang County Lord almost burst into tears.
The officials nearby watched the show with relish and discussed privately——
"Who do you think will win the argument?"
"Anyang County Lord! After all, Prince Ninghua is henpecked. What is Anyang County Lord afraid of?"
Just as they were discussing like this, they saw Cui Jingyan whispering something to Anyang County Lord. The officials who were peeking could not hear the content clearly even if they strained their ears. Then they saw Anyang County Lord looking at Wen Wen in the sedan with a surprised look on his face, and reaching out to grab Wen Wen.
"A fight is about to begin, a fight is about to begin..." The officials waited with bated breath.
Unexpectedly, Anyang County Lord just put his hand in, adjusted the cushion on Wen Wen's back, and then said in a flustered and nervous manner like Cui Jingyan: "Wen Wen, you... let you sit in the sedan! These people are stable enough to lift the sedan, don't worry, I will watch it for you and won't bump you..."
So when everyone looked at each other dumbfounded, the sedan chair was carried away, and Anyang County Lord even followed directly beside it, feeling that he was even more protective of the sedan chair than Cui Jingyan.
Cui Jingyan didn't see the sedan chair until she turned around, nodded to everyone and left slowly.
A group of civil and military officials who were dumbfounded finally let out a sigh of relief when all the protagonists were gone.
"It turns out that Prince Ninghua is just henpecked. This kind of henpecking can also affect others. You should stay away from him in the future to avoid being infected..."
However, in the case of the female relatives, it is a completely different situation——
"It turns out that the princess of Ninghua County can not only make the prince of the county docile, but also the lord of Anyang County. I will have to get close to her in the future and see how she does it..."
At the end, it’s better to continue losing my memory.
Five years later, Wen Wen and Cui Jingyan had a son and a daughter. The little boy is five years old and is a smart and clever boy. The King of Jin said that the child would have great potential in the future. When the child was three years old, he became pregnant again because of his tenderness and could not bear the noise, so the King of Jin and his wife took him to Taiyuan to live with his grandparents for a whole year and personally taught him how to behave.
As for the little girl, who is only two years old, she is very cute and likes to act like a spoiled child. Her soft and tender voice can make people's hearts melt, and they wish they could bring the whole world to her. Contrary to her little brother, the little girl was so cute that Prince Jin and his wife stayed in Beijing for a year specifically for her, fearing that they would miss too much of their granddaughter's growth.
With such a pair of children, Wen Wenwen and Cui Jingyan have shown their compatibility as husband and wife. Their ideas of raising children are not far from each other, and they will not get into discord because of their children's interruption. They are naturally in love with each other and love each other as usual.
They don't think that their children don't understand anything. When getting along with children, they speak and deal with them just like adults and respect their children's ideas. Therefore, after their brother and sister can speak, they express themselves very clearly and think clearly. They are praised as smart children every time they go out.
On this day, Cui Jingyan stopped in the study room and bowed her hands like an adult.
"Dad, I want to ask you something." The boy is small, but he is very polite.
"Come and sit down." Cui Jingyan waved to him, asked her son to sit down next to him, and then pushed the snack box on the table.to his son. "What do you want to ask dad?"
The fact that the boy wanted to ask had been bothering him for a while, so he was not in the mood for snacks. He just opened his big black eyes like glass beads and asked curiously: "Did Mom and Dad hit their heads and lose their memory when they first got married?"
Cui Jingyan's hand that was pouring tea stopped in mid-air.
"Yes." He looked at the little boy in confusion. "How do you know?"
